title: Accounts in the US now require specifying capabilities at creation time
summary: Starting with the 2019-02-19 API, the requested_capabilities property is now required at creation time for accounts in the U.S. To learn more, see Account capabilities.
migrationNotes: This change mandates the inclusion of the requested_capabilities property when creating accounts in the U.S. You must now explicitly specify the capabilities they want for new accounts, which provides more control over account functionalities.

Starting with the 2019-02-19 API, the `requested_capabilities` property is now required at creation time for accounts in the U.S. To learn more, see [Account capabilities](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/account-capabilities.md).
